_meta.rule: Translate every value. Keep labels concise enough for the existing whiteboard layout.

translations.《生产级多智能体系统》第 06 章架构图，使用确定性白板线框表达控制流、证据或责: Chapter 06 architecture diagram for Production-Grade Multi-Agent Systems, using deterministic whiteboard wireframes to show control flow, evidence, or responsibility boundaries.
translations.安全不是十个分类器串联，而是协议、身份、策略、执行、数据和运营边界共同失效隔离。: Security is not ten classifiers in series; it is failure isolation across protocol, identity, policy, execution, data, and operational boundaries.
translations.安全结论来自执行路径和证据，不来自模型的一句“我拒绝”。: Security conclusions come from execution paths and evidence, not from a model saying, “I refuse.”
translations.不同控制阻断不同失效；注入检测漏报后，授权、执行、DLP 和响应仍应成立。: Different controls block different failures; if injection detection misses, authorization, execution, DLP, and response controls must still hold.
translations.不透传 Client Token: Do not pass through Client Token
translations.测试集 ASR = 0 只证明当前版本和当前样本；未知攻击风险仍然存在。: ASR = 0 on the test set proves only the current version against current samples; unknown attack risk remains.
translations.从资产与不变量出发，执行可重复攻击，观察副作用、告警和恢复，再进入发布回归。: Start from assets and invariants; run repeatable attacks, observe side effects, alerts, and recovery, then move into release regression testing.
translations.多 Agent 安全从信任边界开始: Multi-agent security starts with trust boundaries
translations.恶意内容只能影响意图；Manifest、权限交集、资源绑定和释放策略决定真实影响: Malicious content can influence only intent; the Manifest, permission intersection, resource binding, and release policy determine the actual impact.
translations.红队验证是一条持续安全证据闭环: Red-team validation is a continuous security evidence loop
translations.禁止：权限相加 · Token Passthrough · 内部 Peer 默认: Forbidden: Permission union · Token Passthrough · Internal Peer trusted by default
translations.模型可以提出意图；只有确定性边界能够授予权限和执行副作用。: The model may propose intent; only deterministic boundaries can grant permissions and execute side effects.
translations.内部组件也可能处理恶意内容；跨越自然语言、权限和数据边界时必须重新验证。: Internal components may also process malicious content; revalidate whenever crossing natural-language, permission, or data boundaries.
translations.任一条件为空 → DENY: If any condition is empty → DENY
translations.输出打码只是最后一步；数据在进入 Context、Memory、索引和审计前就应: Output masking is only the final step; minimize data before it enters Context, Memory, indexes, and audit.
translations.同一控制面接受红队回归: Red-team regression on the same control plane
translations.修复发现 → 加入回归集 → 重新执行 → 保存证据: Remediate finding → Add to regression set → Rerun → Save evidence
translations.隐私安全是一条用途绑定的数据生命周期: Privacy protection follows a purpose-bound data lifecycle
translations.用户、Agent、委托、任务、工具、资源、环境和审批必须同时允许。: User, Agent, delegation, task, tool, resource, environment, and approval must all allow the action.
translations.原始会话删除后，摘要、长期 Memory、向量索引、Artifact、评测集和备: After a raw session is deleted, summaries, long-term Memory, vector indexes, Artifact records, evaluation sets, and backup expiration must all be handled.
translations.纵深防御：从恶意内容到受控副作用: Defense in depth: from malicious content to controlled side effects
translations.AgentCard / Tool Description 描述能力，不授予权限；: AgentCard / Tool Description describe capabilities, not grant permissions; the receiver must validate every operation.
translations.CaseOps Slice 5：模型可以失守，权限边界不能失守: CaseOps Slice 5: The model may fail; the permission boundary must not
translations.Control / Policy / Dataset / Model / Too: Control / Policy / Dataset / Model / Tool Registry version changes
translations.Encryption 保护传输和存储；它不减少解密后进入模型的敏感内容。: Encryption protects data in transit and at rest; it does not reduce sensitive content entering the model after decryption.
translations.MCP 与 A2A：身份成立后，业务权限仍要重新计算: MCP and A2A: Business permissions must still be recomputed after identity is established
translations.Token 绑定受众，委托逐跳收缩；传输身份和能力描述都不能替代资源授权。: Bind Token to Audience and narrow delegation at every hop; transport identity and capability descriptions cannot replace resource authorization.
translations.Tool Description 帮模型选择；可信 Registry、Polic: Tool Description helps the model choose; a trusted Registry, Policy, and Executor determine whether execution is allowed.
translations.Tool Guard：授权是交集，不是角色查表: Tool Guard: Authorization is an intersection, not a role lookup
